environment.notes: Fresh Actions checkouts. Local chat sandbox had no GitHub DNS. No remote D1, deployment, migration, secrets or paid provider used.

findings.impact: Dependent offline Smart-Marking actions can be sent out of user order when Date.now collides or wall-clock order regresses. The later action can become blocked and prevent the correct predecessor behind it from flushing.
findings.minimalRepro: tests/independentStreetEngineAudit.test.ts :: offline intent queue preserves user order when two actions share one millisecond
findings.observed: a-second-action sent first, blocked with network_work_changed; z-first-action remains queued behind it
findings.fixBoundary: Persist a durable monotonic FIFO sequence per scope or equivalent IndexedDB ordering. Do not use wall-clock plus random key as authoritative ordering. Preserve compatibility for old queued entries.

findings.impact: The explicit approximately 20,000-house target is not supported. Current runtime rejects 20k before publish.
findings.minimalRepro: scripts/street-masterplan-audit.ts via Independent StreetEngine scale audit
findings.expected: 20,000-house synthetic two-tile generation reaches ready only after all publish/sync gates are safe
findings.observed: outcome failed, phase addresses, error_code house_assignment_budget, public code area_preparation_too_many_features
findings.fixBoundary: Do not raise only the constant. Reduce graph rereads, profile phase CPU/heap, and prove 20k publish/feed/sync before changing the capability limit.

findings.impact: Unchanged edge payload is repeatedly read/deserialized per 250-house link slice; retry/crash can multiply work.
findings.expected: Bounded graph reuse or partitioned edge reads without changing canonical D1 authority
findings.fixBoundary: Generation/hash-bound bounded cache or spatial partitioning with cold D1 recovery, measured against the same fixture.

findings.impact: Release governance is contradictory: ADR-0030 says patched MapLibre 6.9.0 is accepted and retaining vulnerable 5.7.1 is rejected, while the current runtime explicitly pins 5.7.1 and whitelists GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579. A green audit is therefore not advisory-free.
findings.minimalRepro: Compare ADR-0030, AGENTS.md, docs/status/CURRENT.md, package.json and scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs at the frozen head/runtime.
findings.expected: One non-contradictory accepted renderer decision and matching dependency policy
findings.observed: 5.7.1 historical-renderer exception is active; no superseding accepted ADR found in the loaded decision set
findings.fixBoundary: Supersede ADR-0030 with an explicit temporary exception and exit criteria, or return to a patched renderer after browser/device acceptance.
